purpose: Maps five agent payment credential classes (shared payment token, network agentic token, API-key card proxy, x402 EIP-3009 permit, wallet delegated session key) across scope, expiry, replay protection, revocability and what the agent can learn. Scope, expiry and replay cells chain to sibling verdicts; revocability and learn are declared facts from closed vocabularies. Columns no cited source settles are marked unpinned and flagged for review.
